L1_ep01.passage_en: I am Jeongmin. I am a student.

questions.q_en: What is Jeongmin?

L1_ep02.passage: 정민은 보미의 친구예요. 정민은 선생님이 아니에요.
L1_ep02.passage_en: Jeongmin is Bomi's friend. Jeongmin is not a teacher.

questions.q_en: Who is Jeongmin to Bomi?

L1_ep03.passage: 저녁이에요. 엄마, 아빠, 동생이 모두 있어요. "잘 먹겠습니다!" 밥이 맛있어요. 다 먹었어요. "잘 먹었습니다!"
L1_ep03.passage_en: It's evening. Mom, Dad, and my sibling are all here. "Thank you for the meal!" The food is delicious. I'm all done eating. "I ate well!"

questions.q_en: When is it?
You're all done eating. What do you say?

L1_ep04.passage: 리나는 보미를 만나요. 두 사람은 오후 세 시에 공원에서 만나요.
L1_ep04.passage_en: Lina meets Bomi. The two meet at the park at 3 PM.

questions.q_en: When do they meet?
Where do they meet?

L1_ep05.passage: 보미하고 올리비아는 광장시장에 가요. 광장시장은 서울에 있는 큰 시장이에요. 두 사람은 버스를 타고 가요. 버스 정류장에서 버스를 기다려요. 광장시장에는 맛있는 음식이 많아요. 두 사람은 떡볶이를 먹으러 가요.
L1_ep05.passage_en: Bomi and Olivia are going to Gwangjang Market. Gwangjang Market is a big market in Seoul. They take the bus to get there. They wait for the bus at the bus stop.

questions.q_en: Where are Bomi and Olivia going?
How do they get there?

L1_ep06.passage: 보미하고 친구들은 포장마차에 가요. 포장마차는 길에 있는 작은 식당이에요. 메뉴판에 김밥하고 떡볶이가 있어요. 보미는 김밥 두 인분을 주문해요. 김밥이 맛있어요. 한국에는 포장마차가 많아요.
L1_ep06.passage_en: Bomi and friends go to a pojangmacha. A pojangmacha is a small street food stall. The menu has gimbap and tteokbokki. Bomi orders two servings of gimbap. The gimbap is delicious. There are many pojangmacha in Korea.

questions.q_en: Where is the pojangmacha?
What does Bomi order?

L1_ep07.passage: 보미는 학교에서 한국어 스터디 그룹을 만들어요. 스터디 그룹에는 학생이 네 명 있어요. 우리는 매주 화요일에 만나요. 도서관에서 같이 공부해요. 한국어를 배우고 싶은 친구들이 많아요. 스터디 그룹이 재미있어요.
L1_ep07.passage_en: Bomi makes a Korean study group at school. There are four students in the study group. They meet every Tuesday. They study together at the library. Many friends want to learn Korean. The study group is fun.

questions.q_en: When does the study group meet?
Where do they study in the group?

L1_ep08.passage: 오늘 리나는 도시락을 잃어버려요. 도시락은 어디에 있을까요? 가방 안에 없어요. 책상 위에도 없어요. 리나는 엄마한테 전화해요. 엄마가 말해요. "냉장고 안에 있어." 도시락이 냉장고 안에 있어요.
L1_ep08.passage_en: Today Lina loses her lunchbox. Where could it be? It's not in her bag. It's not on the desk either. Lina calls her mom. Mom says, 'It's in the refrigerator.' The lunchbox is in the refrigerator.

questions.q_en: What does Lina lose?
Where is the lunchbox?

L1_ep09.passage: 할머니하고 보미는 재래시장에 가요. 재래시장에는 과일, 채소, 생선이 많아요. 할머니는 딸기 두 박스를 사요. 보미는 사과 여섯 개를 사요. 재래시장이 마트보다 싸요. 두 사람은 즐거운 시간을 보내요.
L1_ep09.passage_en: Grandma and Bomi go to a traditional market. The market has lots of fruits, vegetables and fish. Grandma buys two boxes of strawberries. Bomi buys six apples. Traditional markets are cheaper than supermarkets. The two have a good time.

questions.q_en: What does Grandma buy?
How is the traditional market compared to the supermarket?

L1_ep10.passage: 어제 가족이 한강공원에 갔어요. 날씨가 맑고 좋았어요. 아빠하고 라온은 자전거를 탔어요. 엄마는 강가에서 쉬었어요. 보미는 사진을 찍었어요. 우리는 한강에서 라면도 먹었어요. 정말 즐거운 하루였어요.
L1_ep10.passage_en: Yesterday the family went to Hangang Park. The weather was clear and nice. Dad and Raon rode bikes. Mom rested by the river. Bomi took photos. We also ate ramen at the Han River.

questions.q_en: What did Dad and Raon do?
What did the family eat at the Han River?

L1_ep11.passage: 보미 엄마하고 아빠가 라온네 집에 갔어요. 라온 엄마가 "어서 오세요!" 했어요. 손님들은 신발을 벗고 집에 들어갔어요. 라온 엄마가 차를 준비했어요. 두 가족이 거실에 앉아서 이야기를 했어요. 한국에서는 집에 들어갈 때 신발을 벗어요.
L1_ep11.passage_en: Bomi's mom and dad went to Raon's house. Raon's mom said 'Welcome!' The guests took off their shoes and entered the house. Raon's mom prepared tea. The two families sat in the living room and talked.

questions.q: 집에 들어갈 때 뭘 해야 해요?
questions.q_en: What do you have to do when entering the house?
Where did the two families sit?

L1_ep12.passage: 여름방학이에요. 보미하고 리나는 경복궁에 갈 거예요. 경복궁은 서울에 있는 오래된 궁궐이에요. 두 사람은 한복을 입을 수 있어요. 경복궁 안에는 박물관도 있어요. 보미는 사진을 많이 찍을 거예요.
L1_ep12.passage_en: It's summer vacation. Bomi and Lina are going to Gyeongbokgung Palace. Gyeongbokgung is an old palace in Seoul. The two can wear hanbok there. There is also a museum inside the palace.

questions.q_en: Where are Bomi and Lina going?
What is inside Gyeongbokgung?

L2_ep01.passage: 보미가 드디어 공항에 도착했어요. 공항에서 캐나다에서 온 사촌들을 만났어요. "오랜만이야! 잘 있었어?" 사촌이 말했어요. 전화가 안 되면 할머니를 못 만나니까, 우선 통신사에 가서 번호표를 뽑고 심카드를 사야 돼요. 이제 전화가 연결돼서 할머니한테 전화할 수 있어요.
L2_ep01.passage_en: Bomi finally arrived at the airport. At the airport she met her cousins who had come from Canada. "Long time no see! How have you been?" her cousin said. If the phone doesn't connect she can't meet grandma, so first she has to go to the carrier shop, get a number ticket, and buy a SIM card. Now that the phone is connected, she can call grandma.

questions.q_en: Who did Bomi meet at the airport?

questions.q: 전화를 연결하려면 먼저 뭘 해야 돼요?
questions.q_en: What does Bomi have to do first to connect her phone?

L2_ep02.passage: 보미는 공항에서 잠실까지 가야 돼요. 출구 근처 매표소를 찾아 봤지만 못 찾았어요. 표지판을 봐도 터미널행 버스가 안 보여요. 사촌이 "제가 찾아 볼게요"라고 말하고 공항버스를 찾았어요. 짐을 들고 버스를 타서 종점에 무사히 도착했어요.
L2_ep02.passage_en: Bomi has to get from the airport to Jamsil. She looked for the ticket booth near the exit but couldn't find it. Even looking at the signs, she couldn't see the terminal-bound bus. Her cousin said "I'll go look" and found the airport bus. They carried their luggage, got on the bus, and arrived safely at the last stop.

questions.q_en: Where does Bomi need to go from and to?

questions.q: 두 사람은 결국 어디까지 무사히 도착했어요?
questions.q_en: Where did the two of them safely arrive in the end?

L2_ep03.passage: 라온이 개울에서 첨벙첨벙 놀았어요. 개구리하고 올챙이를 잡으면서 놀았어요. 그런데 (물에서) 놀아서 감기에 걸린 것 같아요. 몸이 오슬오슬 떨리고 머리가 지끈지끈 아파요. 열이 나니까 병원에 가야 하고, 며칠 동안은 못 놀아요.
L2_ep03.passage_en: Raon played splashing around in the stream. He played catching frogs and tadpoles. But it seems like he caught a cold from playing (in the water). His body is shivering and his head is throbbing. Since he has a fever he has to go to the hospital, and he can't play for a few days.

questions.q: 라온이 왜 감기에 걸린 것 같아요?
questions.q_en: Why does it seem Raon caught a cold?
How does Raon's body feel right now?

L2_ep04.passage: 날씨가 꾸물꾸물하고 우중충해요. 비가 올 것 같아요. 리나가 "헐, 오늘 놀이공원 가는 날인데!"라고 말했어요. 보미가 "비가 와도 그냥 가자! 어차피 재미있을 거야"라고 했어요. 결국 비가 와서 옷이 좀 젖었지만 두 사람은 정말 즐거웠어요.
L2_ep04.passage_en: The weather is cloudy and gloomy. It looks like it's going to rain. Lina said, "Ugh, today's the day we're going to the amusement park!" Bomi said, "Let's just go even if it rains! It'll be fun anyway." In the end it rained and their clothes got a little wet, but the two of them had a really great time.

questions.q_en: What is the weather like today?

questions.q: 리나하고 보미는 비가 와도 어디에 갔어요?
questions.q_en: Where did Lina and Bomi go even though it rained?

L2_ep05.passage: 용문사에 가면 아주 오래되고 큰 은행나무를 볼 수 있어요. 이 나무는 천연기념물인데, 정말 오래오래 살았어요. 옛날에 마의 태자가 이 곳에 지팡이를 꽂았다는 이야기가 있어요. 그 지팡이가 나무가 됐다고 하니까 마법 같잖아요. 사람들은 지금도 이 나무한테 소원을 빌어요.
L2_ep05.passage_en: If you go to Yongmunsa, you can see a very old, big ginkgo tree. This tree is a natural monument, and it has lived for a really long time. There's a story that long ago Crown Prince Ma-ui stuck his walking stick here. Since that walking stick became this tree, it's like magic, right? People still make wishes to this tree today.

questions.q_en: What is the Yongmunsa ginkgo tree like?
What do people do to the ginkgo tree?

L2_ep06.passage: 마트에서 계산을 할 때 직원이 물었어요. "회원권이 있으세요?" 리나는 회원권이 없었어요. 직원이 만들어 드릴까요 하고 물었어요. 리나는 회원권을 만들었어요. 이제 포인트를 모을 수 있어요. 마트 회원이 되면 할인도 받을 수 있어요.
L2_ep06.passage_en: At checkout a staff member asked if Lina had a membership card. Lina did not have one. The staff offered to make one. Lina got a membership card. Now she can collect points and get discounts as a member.

questions.q_en: Did Lina have a membership card?

questions.q: 회원이 되면 뭘 모을 수 있어요?
questions.q_en: What can you collect as a member?

L2_ep07.passage: 라온이 할머니한테서 단골집 이야기를 들었어요. 오랜만에 거기에 가려고 해요. "할머니, 같이 냉면 드실래요?" 라온이 물었어요. 할머니는 차가운 음식을 잘 드시지 못해서 "그럼 나는 따뜻한 설렁탕 먹을래"라고 하셨어요. 라온이 메뉴를 주문하고 반찬도 더 주문해 드렸어요.
L2_ep07.passage_en: Raon heard about a favorite restaurant from grandma. He's planning to go there again after a long time. "Grandma, want to have naengmyeon together?" Raon asked. Grandma can't eat cold food well, so she said, "Then I'll have warm seolleongtang." Raon ordered the food and also ordered extra side dishes for her.

questions.q_en: Why didn't grandma have naengmyeon?
What did Raon do for grandma?

L2_ep08.passage: 할머니가 된장국을 끓이기 전에 장독대에서 된장을 펐어요. 멸치로 다시물을 만든 후에 두부하고 애호박을 깍뚝깍뚝 썰었어요. 파는 송송 썰고 양파는 얄팍얄팍 썰었어요. 다시물이 보글보글 끓기 시작하면 된장을 풀고 야채를 듬뿍 넣어요. 된장국이 끓는 동안 할머니가 뚝배기를 준비했어요.
L2_ep08.passage_en: Before making doenjang-guk, grandma scooped doenjang out of the jangdokdae. After making anchovy broth, she diced the tofu and squash. She sliced the green onion round and thin, and sliced the onion into thin slices. When the broth starts bubbling, she dissolves in the doenjang and adds plenty of vegetables. While the soup was boiling, grandma got the ttukbaegi ready.

questions.q: 할머니는 된장국을 끓이기 전에 어디서 된장을 펐어요?
questions.q_en: Where did grandma scoop the doenjang from before cooking?
What do they add once the broth starts boiling?

L2_ep09.passage: 여름방학에 가족이 킬라니 주립공원으로 캠핑을 가요. 할머니가 늘 자랑하는 "행운의 자리"를 예약했어요. 그 자리는 호수 바로 위에 있는데, 시야가 탁 트여서 경치가 최고예요. 경치를 감상하면서 저녁을 먹을 때 정말 딱 좋은 것 같아요. 곰이 있을 수도 있으니까 밤에는 조심해야 돼요.
L2_ep09.passage_en: During summer break the family goes camping at Killarney Provincial Park. They reserved the "lucky spot" grandma always brags about. That spot is right above the lake, with a wide-open view and the best scenery. Enjoying the scenery while eating dinner feels just perfect. Since there might be bears, they have to be careful at night.

questions.q: 가족은 언제 킬라니 주립공원에 캠핑을 가요?
questions.q_en: When does the family go camping at Killarney Provincial Park?
Where is the "lucky spot"?

L2_ep10.passage: 차를 타고 가는데 보미가 멀미해요. 머리도 어지럽고 두통도 있어요. 토하지는 않았지만 정말 힘들어요. "좀 참아 봐, 조금만 더 가면 휴게소에 도착해." 아빠가 말했어요. 휴게소에서 쉬게 되니까 몸이 나아진 것 같고, 빙수도 먹어서 기분이 괜찮아졌어요.
L2_ep10.passage_en: While riding in the car, Bomi gets carsick. Her head is dizzy and she has a headache too. She didn't throw up, but she's really having a hard time. "Hang in there a bit, we'll get to the rest stop soon," dad said. Resting at the rest stop, she seems to be feeling better, and after eating bingsu her mood improved too.

questions.q_en: Why is Bomi having a hard time in the car?
How does Bomi feel after resting at the rest stop?

L2_ep11.passage: 차 안에서 밖을 내다보면 양쪽에 바다가 보여요. "우와, 여기 정말 아름답네요!" 리나가 말했어요. 할머니가 "여기가 옛날엔 그냥 바다였거든"이라고 하셨어요. "새만금 방조제는 바닷물을 가두려고 만든 거잖아." 할아버지가 말씀하셨어요. 리나는 자연풍광에 홀딱 반해서 "여기서 더 놀아야겠어요."라고 하고, 보미도 "다음에 또 왔으면 좋겠어요"라고 말했어요.
L2_ep11.passage_en: Looking out the window in the car, you can see the sea on both sides. "Wow, it's so beautiful here!" Lina said. Grandma said, "This used to just be the ocean, you know." "The Saemangeum Seawall was built to hold back the seawater, remember?" grandpa explained. Lina fell completely in love with the natural scenery and said, "I should play here more." Bomi added, "I hope we come again."

questions.q_en: What was the Saemangeum Seawall built to do?
Why was Lina amazed by this place?

L2_ep12.passage: 할머니가 내소사 이야기를 해 주셨어요. 원래 이름은 소래사였는데 조선 후기부터 내소사라고 해요. 옛날에 스님이 대웅보전을 짓고 있었는데, 어떤 목공이 와서 도와줬대요. 사람들은 그 목공이 사실 호랑이가 변신한 거라고 해요. 호랑이는 문살에 예쁜 무늬를 만들어 놓고 갑자기 사라져 버렸대요.
L2_ep12.passage_en: Grandma told the story of Naesosa temple. Its original name was Soraesa, and it's been called Naesosa since the late Joseon period. Long ago a monk was building the main hall, and a carpenter came and helped. People say that carpenter was actually a tiger in disguise. The tiger made pretty patterns on the door lattice, and then suddenly disappeared.

questions.q_en: What was the original name of Naesosa?
What do people say the carpenter actually was?
